tickets.title: Conduct Benefits Enrollment Outreach
tickets.text:
Outreach purpose: benefits enrollment support for Ellis Bramblequill.

Message outline:
1. Confirm the enrollment window or relative deadline: by 2025-09-30.
2. Request current benefits materials: benefits guide, rate sheet, portal summary.
3. Ask about expected changes: HSA, disability coverage, supplemental life insurance, retirement contribution choices.
4. Identify decisions to review: health plan, HSA or FSA, disability, life insurance, retirement contributions.
5. If contacting a benefits professional, request clarification on: plan rules, employer match, coverage effective date, eligibility.
6. Close with next step: schedule review.

Do not provide final election instructions until plan documents and client priorities have been reviewed.
Review Ellis Bramblequill’s Cloudberry Kite Analytics benefits guide, rate sheet, and portal summary against HSA, disability coverage, supplemental life insurance, and retirement contribution choices.

Summarize findings for advisor review and client follow-up. Obtain the Asheville homeowners declarations page, current umbrella declarations page, and premium notice from the insurance portal.

subTasks.title: Collect Current Policy Evidence
subTasks.text: Gather declarations pages, in-force illustrations where applicable, premium notices, beneficiary records, ownership details, and any recent carrier correspondence.

subTasks.title: Analyze Coverage and Planning Fit
subTasks.text: Compare policy type, coverage amount, riders, premiums, cash value or surrender details, beneficiary designations, and ownership against the client's planning objectives and known risks.

subTasks.title: Prepare Advisor Recommendation Summary
subTasks.text: Document recommended keep, revise, replace, or monitor actions; note questions for the carrier or insurance professional; and identify any estate, tax, or cash-flow considerations.
